error - LazyInitializationException on department proxy inside AiChatService.buildSystemPrompt:

-> department and branch are lazy proxies tied to that dead session

commits.author: Ja'farbek Yusupov
commits.message:
feat: new crud endpoints for entities (#14), other minor fixes&add-ons (#16|#15|#13|#12)

- feat: update and delete endpoints for branch, dept, category, type | #14
- - each entity type instance has to meet certain criteria to be deleted
  (whether its a hard or soft delete); e.g for dept it is to have no
  users and have no assets, while for branch - no active depts and same
  requirements as for branch. TLDR: the higher entity is in hierarchy,
  the harder it is for it to be deleted
- - soft delete for branch and dept (using isActive flag and archivedAt
  timestamp - V18 migration)
- feat(category): endpoint to create category with types in one call | #15
- bug(analytics/overview): return full data by statuses | #13
- - overview currently returns stats by statuses of assets that exist
- - when there are no instances of assets for specific status type, nothing is returned for that status.
- - fix: return zero, if no assets for given status
- feat(user): search param for user/list | #12
- - optional search query param for GET user/list, seach done for:
- - - department name
- - - fullName
- - - email
- fix(asset/assignment): fix logical errors in status transition processes | #16
- - let admin assign asset from one user to another (by completing and following the logical trace in the background:
- - - close assignment record for current user
- - - change status to registered
- - - assign asset to new user (upd asset status to assigned again
- - - open assignment record for the new user
